README: Hand-made scenes for the answer prompt v3 example and the T3 template tests (docs/plans/phase-4.md, tuning T3, owner 2026-11-16). Modelled on train_317 ('Theo các biển trong ảnh, loại xe nào bị cấm đi vào?'); the time plate is added by hand so the ban is conditional. Nothing is copied from dataset files.

examples.summary: Which vehicles are banned from entering? P.110a with a time plate, no time asked: a conditional ban.
The same with a second sign, P.106a without a plate: trucks banned outright, bicycles conditionally.
